question: Which of the following instruments is used to measure wind speed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anemometer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• An **anemometer** is a device used for **measuring wind speed and direction**.
 
• It is a common instrument used in meteorology and aerodynamics.
 
• The term is derived from the Greek word 'anemos', meaning wind.
 
• Anemometers can be classified into different types such as cup anemometers, vane anemometers, hot-wire anemometers, and laser Doppler anemometers.
 
• The most common type is the cup anemometer, which consists of three or four cups attached to horizontal arms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ammeter**

 
 
• An ammeter is an instrument used to **measure the current in a circuit**.
 
• It is **connected in series **with the circuit whose current is to be measured.
 
 
 
• **Udometer**
 
 
• A udometer, also known as a **rain gauge**, is an instrument used to **measure the amount of liquid precipitation **over a set period of time.
 
 
 
• **Hygrometer**
 
 
• A hygrometer is an instrument used to **measure the moisture content in the atmosphere**, i.e., humidity.
